name: Calendar Info
description: Calendar notifications on your Stream Deck: see your next event with a live countdown that changes color as it approaches, browse your agenda on a key or a dial, and press to join the meeting. Reads any iCalendar (.ics) feed - a URL, a webcal:// address or a local file - or talks to Google Calendar directly, using either your own OAuth client or an account you have already added to KDE's Online Accounts.
short-description: Next event, countdown and agenda from iCalendar feeds or Google Calendar.
